title: The best part about Claude Code is that you can just ask it to build stuff. Need a 3D physics engine? Claude will build it!
author: ledniv
selftext:
Want to make a game with the new 3D physics engine? Claude will build that too!

The physics engine took Claude a few hours. The game took about 1 day.

Emoji Smash 3D - [**https://nitzan.games/play/emoji-smash-3d**](https://nitzan.games/play/emoji-smash-3d)

3D Physics engine on GitHub - [https://github.com/nitzangames/Physics3D](https://github.com/nitzangames/Physics3D)

comments.author: Chaibi_Alaa
comments.body: Good luck with generating good looking 2D sprites or 3d elements with claude code alone

replies.author: MakanLagiDud3
replies.body: Hey man, no need to be mean. Won't be easy but I think it can be done

replies.author: The-Happy-Cow-Arts
replies.body: You're getting down voted by angry mean people.

replies.author: Chaibi_Alaa
replies.body: My comment was not by any way a mean one, and I didn't downvote you :)

replies.author: ledniv
replies.body:
Claude made all the art assets in this game: [https://nitzan.games/play/formula-champions-3d](https://nitzan.games/play/formula-champions-3d)

Not amazing, but not terrible either.

comments.author: MilkLover090
comments.body:
whats the benefit to using this over unity? 

i legitimately could remake this in under an hour with unity

replies.author: ledniv
replies.body:
I mean... It's cool? 

Also don't have to be tied to someone else's engine. If Unity decides tomorrow to charge per download, you don't have to worry.

replies.author: Glooring3623
replies.body: Unity makes you to pay to use your custom splash screen, that's enough.

replies.author: WittleSus
replies.body: You're coming at this like they're trying to sell you something. They're not, they just think it's cool that claude built it themselves. Relax.

comments.author: poponis
comments.body: Why are you sharing the repo for the engine? Claude can build it.

replies.author: ledniv
replies.body:
Ha, its true! 

Although in all seriousness, I included it because when Claude made a 2D physics engine, people claimed it just used Box2D. So the repo is proof that Claude really built it.
